channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Ex-Ark Encounter, Creation Museum band member gets 15 years for abusing teenage boy
item.description: Michael Howard, a former member of TrueSong — the resident musical act of the Ark Encounter and Creation Museum in Northern Kentucky — has been sentenced to 15 years in prison after pleading guilty to sexually abusing a teenage boy for several years in the congregation where he served as worship leader. #MichaelHoward #Abuse #ArkEncounter

item.title: 'Degrading and dangerous': Nurses forced to undress in front of trans-identified man celebrate court victory
item.description: A group of nurses have won their case against the NHS after they were forced to share their changing room with a trans-identifying man. #NHS #nurses #transgender #changingrooms

item.title: Renee Good's father-in-law doesn't blame ICE for her death, urges Americans to 'turn to God'
item.description: The ex-father-in-law of Minneapolis shooting victim Renee Good says he doesn't blame Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) for her death, and is calling on Americans to “turn to God" at this time. #ICE #ReneeGood #Minneapolis #Minnesota #illegalimmigration

item.title: Celebrity ad promoting males in girls' sports draws ire of champion gymnast: 'Bodies play sports, not identities'
item.description: A former champion gymnast has condemned an ad campaign featuring actress Naomi Watts, U.S. soccer star Megan Rapinoe and other celebrities advocating for males to be allowed to participate in girls' sports, as the U.S. Supreme Court considers two cases related to laws prohibiting male trans-identified athletes from competing with females. #NaomiWatts #MeganRapinoe #ACLU #ElliotPage #transgender #SupremeCourt #womenssports #JenniferSey

item.title: 'Prophet' Brian Carn pleads guilty to obstructing IRS, claims he won’t go to prison
item.description: Self-styled prophet and leader of Kingdom City Church in North Carolina, Brian Carn Jr. is now facing three years in prison after pleading guilty to obstructing the IRS’ efforts to collect more than $600,00 in outstanding taxes. He insists however that he won’t be going to prison because he knows how to “handle that stuff in the spirit.” #BrianCarn #IRS #Guilty #Obstructing

item.title: Republicans urge Trump to crack down on shipment of abortion drugs across state lines
item.description: Republican leaders and state attorneys general called on the Trump administration to crack down on the shipment of abortion drugs across state lines, expressing frustration with the speed of a safety review and the remaining Biden-era mail-order abortion pill policy that they contend subverts state laws. #Trumpadministration #abortionpill #mifepristone #FDA #prolifemovement

item.title: 'Victory for life': Red Rose Rescuers celebrate seeing all charges dropped in abortion clinic trespassing case
item.description: A group of pro-life activists are celebrating after trespassing charges were dropped against them for actions that resulted in the closure of an abortion clinic last year. They’re hailing the court’s decision as a “victory for life.” #Abortion #RedRoseRescue #prolife #abortionprotest

item.title: 7 women among 10 filing new sex abuse lawsuits naming Paul Havsgaard, Harvest Christian Fellowship
item.description: Seven women are among 10 new individuals who recently filed federal lawsuits alleging they were repeatedly sexually abused and trafficked by former Harvest Christian Fellowship pastor Paul Havsgaard while living in now-defunct children’s homes in Romania operated by the California megachurch. #HarvestChristianFellowship #GregLaurie #PaulHavsgaard #Romania #SexualAbuse

item.title: Relative of Charlie Kirk shooting suspect's trans roommate speaks out for the first time
item.description: A relative of Lance Twiggs, the trans-identifying roommate and romantic partner of alleged Charlie Kirk killer Tyler Robinson, shared new details about the pair’s relationship and how the killing has impacted her family. #CharlieKirkassassination #TylerRobinson #LanceTwiggs #TPUSA #FBI

item.title: Vice President JD Vance to speak at 53rd annual March for Life
item.description: Vice President JD Vance is scheduled to deliver in-person remarks at the 53rd annual March for Life rally in Washington, D.C., the largest annual pro-life gathering in the United States. #MarchforLife #abortion #prolife #JDVance #Vance #Trump #NationalMall
